title: Introducing the Enhanced Spyglass
summary: Experience the newly launched and greatly enhanced Spyglass tool, designed to empower you with even greater insights and capabilities.

title: Your Files, Your Way
summary: Gain unprecedented command over your content by easily uploading, managing, and showcasing your files exactly as you envision, right within the editor.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We're excited to launch our new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into our past achievements, current progress, and future innovations.

title: Effortless Checkbox Interactions
summary: Our enhanced checkboxes now offer effortless interaction, becoming larger, simpler to click, and fully draggable to streamline your workflow.

title: Improved Live Collaboration
summary: Experience a vastly improved real-time collaboration environment, making it more intuitive and effortless to work together with your team.

title: Unlock Seamless Sharing and Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on all relevant shared items across your network, making teamwork more integrated and visible than ever before.

title: Worldwide Language Support
summary: Noeko is now available in multiple international languages, providing an inclusive and personalized experience for our growing global community.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement in development, and complete transparency into our progress.

title: Elevated Graph View: Discover, Connect, Collaborate
summary: Transform your graph view into a powerful command center for discovery and collaboration with new filters for tags and time, and the ability to visualize your shared content and connections.

title: Precision Search & Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly refine your knowledge with advanced filtering and sorting options, then save your curated views as custom collections for quick access to exactly what you need.

title: Flexible Content Views
summary: Effortlessly organize and visualize your connected content with new, flexible display options designed to enhance your workflow and understanding.

title: Noeko's New Era: Flexible Plans & Self-Managed Hosting
summary: Prepare to unlock Noeko with brand-new flexible plans, empowering you to host it on your own servers for full control or leverage our easy cloud service, complete with free and premium options.

title: Elevate Your Style: Brand New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: Discover an expanded collection of visually stunning themes and enjoy perfected designs that bring a fresh, elegant feel to your Noeko platform.

title: Smarter, More Accurate Greetings
summary: We're enhancing the app to ensure your time-based greetings, like "Good morning" or "Good evening," always perfectly reflect your local time, making your experience more personal and delightful.

title: Instant Actions for Tagged Items
summary: Take immediate control of your tagged content by directly managing items within any tag list, allowing you to quickly unapply tags, delete entries, or view details without navigating away.

title: Bring in More Content Types
summary: Expand your research capabilities by seamlessly integrating a wider array of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, directly into your workflow.
